id: \bMany people use Fighting types when battling, as was tradition. It's no longer required though.
en: \bMany people use Fighting types when battling, as was tradition. It's no longer required though.
it: \bMolti usano tipi Lotta in battaglia, com'era tradizione. Ma ormai non è più obbligatorio.

id: \bThe Clubsplosion happens every so often. It's fun, but nothing like the Pokémon league.
en: \bThe Clubsplosion happens every so often. It's fun, but nothing like the Pokémon league.
it: \bIl Clubsplosion si tiene ogni tanto. È divertente, ma niente a che vedere con la Lega Pokémon.

id: \bMy Throh and I will win. We won last year after all.
en: \bMy Throh and I will win. We won last year after all.
it: \bIo e il mio Throh vinceremo. Dopotutto abbiamo vinto l'anno scorso.

id: \rNot many people enter the tournament. It would take too long if it did.
en: \rNot many people enter the tournament. It would take too long if it did.
it: \rNon si iscrive molta gente al torneo. Altrimenti ci vorrebbe troppo tempo.

id: \bI have a Psychic type. Would that be too unfair? A lot of people are using Fighting types.
en: \bI have a Psychic type. Would that be too unfair? A lot of people are using Fighting types.
it: \bHo un tipo Psico. Sarebbe troppo sleale? Un sacco di gente usa tipi Lotta.
